'''Bruner''' was the owner of a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Signs advertising Bruner's establishment could be seen throughout the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].
